energy_non_negative_damping.definition: min over configurations, modes and resolved frequencies of B_mm

geometry.definition: finest-mesh displaced volume vs analytic Cb*L*B*T

infinite_frequency_added_mass_catamaran.definition: same comparison for the two-hull configuration

infinite_frequency_from_kramers_kronig.definition: |A(inf) from the Kramers-Kronig moment of the measured B - A_pressure_release| / A_pressure_release, worst mode

negative_control_singularity.definition: gap -> 0 raises the interference and superposed hulls break the system

zero_frequency_damping.definition: max_m [ B_m(omega_min) / max_omega B_m ] over the resolved sweep (each mode normalised by its own peak)
